kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: Judges have put Trump's arch and golf course on hold, but only for a matter of days
wire.summary: A federal judge has twice delayed construction of Trump's arch. Another is keeping East Potomac Park open. The proposed golf course redesign got mixed feedback from a federal arts panel on Thursday.

wire.title: The 'Magic Six': How to strengthen your marriage in midlife
wire.summary: How do we maintain healthy romantic relationships as we age? Allison Aubrey and Scott Detrow talk about about the science of healthy, later-in-life relationships.

wire.title: 'Bigger than Barack Obama's election': Scholars reflect on Mississippi Senate race
wire.summary: Scott Colom is now this Southern state's first Black U.S. senator in nearly 150 years. Scholars and Mississippi natives Eddie Glaude and Kiese Laymon discuss the historic significance of his victory.

wire.title: The midterms were the largest win for either party in 50 years
wire.summary: Some 56% of people cast votes for Democrats in House races, compared to 42% who voted Republican. That 14-point spread is the widest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.

wire.title: The U.N.'s top court rules Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya
wire.summary: The International Court of Justice found that Myanmar security forces "acted with genocidal intent" against the Rohingya during military operations in the northern Rakhine state in 2017.

wire.title: World Toilet Day is a funny idea with a serious goal: A world awash in toilets
wire.summary: Yahoo for the loo! November 19 marks the 25th anniversary of World Toilet Day. The theme this year: "Sanitation and Gender Equality: Safe Toilets, Equal Futures."

wire.title: Anthropic raises more than $100B in IPO. And, Dems nominate Jeffries for House speaker
wire.summary: Despite growing concern over a possible AI bubble, Anthropic had a record-breaking initial public offering. And, Hakeem Jeffries could become the first Black Speaker of the House.

wire.title: Incoming House majority leader Katherine Clark stresses Democratic unity
wire.summary: As Democrats prepare to take control of the House, incoming majority leader Katherine Clark discusses the party's ambitious agenda and divisions within its ranks.

wire.title: Investors scramble for a piece of AI giant Anthropic in blockbuster IPO
wire.summary: Shares in the maker of the popular Claude artificial intelligence model leapt in first day of trading on the Nasdaq Thursday.

wire.title: Muslims will outnumber Christians worldwide by 2035, report says
wire.summary: By 2070, the Democratic Republic of the Congo will surpass the United States as the country with the largest total number of Christians.

wire.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
wire.summary: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

wire.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
wire.summary: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

wire.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
wire.summary: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

wire.title: Dozens missing after boat carrying migrants sinks off Senegal's coast
wire.summary: At least four bodies have been recovered from the boat which was reportedly carrying between 50 and 100 people.

wire.title: Putin vows 'far more painful' response to Ukraine's strikes on Crimean Bridge
wire.summary: The bridge - a symbol of Russia's occupation of the Crimean Peninsula - suffered major damaged following a combined attack by Ukraine earlier this week.

wire.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record $190.4m after row over its Nazi history
wire.summary: Châtaigniers en fleurs was painted in 1890 in the final two months of Vincent van Gogh's life.
